events.name: jh-select
events.description: Dispatched when text is selected. Event payload contains the selected text, the starting index of the selection, and the ending index of the selection. These values can be accessed via `e.detail.state.selection`, `e.detail.state.selectionStart`, and `e.detail.state.selectionEnd`. Unlike other inputs, this event does not bubble or cross the shadow boundary, so it is only observable on the element itself.

events.name: jh-change
events.description: Dispatched when the value of the input has changed and input loses focus. Event payload includes the value of the input and can be accessed via `e.detail.state.value`. Payload also includes the raw/unformatted value when an input mask is applied and can be accessed via `e.detail.state.rawValue`. Payload also includes the `maxlength` and `minlength` values and can be accessed via `e.detail.reference.maxlength` and `e.detail.reference.minlength` as well as the `pattern` value and can be accessed via `e.detail.reference.pattern`.

events.name: jh-input
events.description: Dispatched when the value of the input has changed. Event payload includes the value of the input and can be accessed via `e.detail.state.value`. Payload also includes the raw/unformatted value when an input mask is applied and can be accessed via `e.detail.state.rawValue`. Payload also includes the `maxlength` and `minlength` values and can be accessed via `e.detail.reference.maxlength` and `e.detail.reference.minlength` as well as the `pattern` value and can be accessed via `e.detail.reference.pattern`.

events.name: jh-maxlength
events.description: Dispatched when the `maxlength` property is set and it's value is reached. Event payload includes the `maxlength` value and can be accessed via `e.detail.reference.maxlength`.

events.name: jh-input:clear-button-click
events.description: Dispatched when the clear button is activated. Event payload contains the previous value of the input field before it was cleared and can be accessed via `e.detail.state.previousValue`. Payload also contains the method used to activate the clear button (mouse or keyboard) and can be accessed via `e.detail.reference.clearMethod`.

events.name: jh-select
events.description: Dispatched when text is selected. Event payload contains the selected text, the starting index of the selection, and the ending index of the selection. These values can be accessed via `e.detail.state.selection`, `e.detail.state.selectionStart`, and `e.detail.state.selectionEnd`.

events.name: jh-change
events.description: Dispatched when the value of the input has changed and input loses focus. Event payload includes the value of the input and can be accessed via `e.detail.state.value`. Payload also includes the raw/unformatted value when an input mask is applied and can be accessed via `e.detail.state.rawValue`. Payload also includes the `maxlength` and `minlength` values and can be accessed via `e.detail.reference.maxlength` and `e.detail.reference.minlength` as well as the `pattern` value and can be accessed via `e.detail.reference.pattern`.

events.name: jh-input
events.description: Dispatched when the value of the input has changed. Event payload includes the value of the input and can be accessed via `e.detail.state.value`. Payload also includes the raw/unformatted value when an input mask is applied and can be accessed via `e.detail.state.rawValue`. Payload also includes the `maxlength` and `minlength` values and can be accessed via `e.detail.reference.maxlength` and `e.detail.reference.minlength` as well as the `pattern` value and can be accessed via `e.detail.reference.pattern`.

events.name: jh-maxlength
events.description: Dispatched when the `maxlength` property is set and it's value is reached. Event payload includes the `maxlength` value and can be accessed via `e.detail.reference.maxlength`.

events.name: jh-input:clear-button-click
events.description: Dispatched when the clear button is activated. Event payload contains the previous value of the input field before it was cleared and can be accessed via `e.detail.state.previousValue`. Payload also contains the method used to activate the clear button (mouse or keyboard) and can be accessed via `e.detail.reference.clearMethod`.

events.description: Dispatched when text is selected. Event payload contains the selected text, the starting index of the selection, and the ending index of the selection. events.name: jh-input
events.description: Dispatched when the value of the input has changed. Event payload includes the value of the input and can be accessed via `e.detail.state.value`. Payload also includes the raw/unformatted value when an input mask is applied and can be accessed via `e.detail.state.rawValue`. Payload also includes the `maxlength` and `minlength` values and can be accessed via `e.detail.reference.maxlength` and `e.detail.reference.minlength` as well as the `pattern` value and can be accessed via `e.detail.reference.pattern`.

events.name: jh-input:clear-button-click
